faq.q: What is Goodtime Gear in GTA 6?
faq.a: Goodtime Gear is a capsule collection of apparel and accessories confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content. Rockstar describes it as inspired by Macca the Gator, a fictional television character from the in-game Goodtime State.

faq.q: Is Goodtime Gear a real clothing brand?
faq.a: No. Macca the Gator, the character it is based on, is described in the record as a fictional in-universe TV character rather than a real brand, unlike Electric Fang Tattoo's real-world FAILE collective tie-in.

faq.q: Is Goodtime Gear a physical store in GTA 6?
faq.a: The record describes it as functioning primarily as a themed merchandise line rather than a walk-in storefront, unlike Rideout Customs or Stock 305. It is still bundled with the game's other confirmed Ultimate Edition businesses.

faq.q: Who can access Goodtime Gear in GTA 6?
faq.a: Only Ultimate Edition owners. It was revealed alongside Rockstar's other confirmed Ultimate Edition storefronts and is not part of the Standard Edition.

faq.q: Where does the Goodtime Gear name come from?
faq.a: It is tied to Macca the Gator, described as a character from the fictional in-game Goodtime State. Rockstar has not said whether the collection ties into any specific mission or location beyond that inspiration.

notKnown: Whether Goodtime Gear items can be worn during story missions or are purely cosmetic add-ons.

howWeKnow: Rockstar's Official Site published this as part of its Ultimate Edition content breakdown on 24 June 2026, ahead of pre-orders opening the next day. GameSpot's coverage from the same date serves as the record's source, which places this at the level of major press reporting rather than a community rumour.
